_doc: Text and placement for tools/t2/rednote_zh.py. Coordinates are 1920x1080 px; x is the block's centre, y its bottom edge (top: true, its top edge).
cues: by SRT number of deliverables/subtitles/hold_fire.zh-Hans.srt. A cue not listed is burned at x 960, y default_y, White, with the track's text and times.

drop: reason (not burned). text: baked wording (replaces the track's). start, end: baked times. style: White (halo, on dark or busy ground), Ink (on paper), or Orange / Teal (a tag's Chinese, in the speaker's colour, under or beside the tag; OrangeInk / TealInk on paper). size: as in the shipped scripts, 70 = a 48 px em.
segs: the same cue continuing across a cut or a phrase: the first seg starts at the cue's start, each later one at its at; a seg may change any field.
extra: on-screen text the track has no cue for: t0, t1, text, and the same placement fields.
tags: the chess tags, tracked per frame (--track): their Chinese and size.
note: why it sits there; not read by the script.
